name: v2-homing-no-trigger
review: The configured X homing direction and 1 mm travel predict -80 steps at 80 steps/mm. Endstops.cpp commands that limit, broadcasts halt if the endstop did not trigger, and emits the required homing failure message. Independent tick-rounded integration at 100 mm/s² predicts the recorded 19,802-tick final pulse; no following move executes. Both real firmware revisions reproduced the trace and alarm. Physical endstops and board timing are not validated.
